summary: Smart Digital Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignations of CEO Yunting Chen (effective May 8, 2026) and Chairman Sam Wai Hong (effective May 9, 2026), both for personal reasons with no disagreement stated. Yiwei Wang was appointed CEO on May 8, and Lin Kon Fatt was appointed Chairman on May 9. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The resignations are immediate, suggesting a planned transition. Watch for any subsequent filings regarding strategy or operational changes.
